signIn.unsecuredBody: Nothing proves who owns this account yet. The caregiver can finish setting it up from “Finish setting up your account” on the caregiver sign-in page, using registration number
signIn.issueHint: A code is normally sent to their phone or email. If they no longer have either, check who they are yourself, then issue a code to give them. It works for 48 hours.
signIn.existingCode: A code you issued earlier is valid until
signIn.issueError: Could not issue a code. Please try again.
signIn.codeShownOnce: This code is shown only once - give it to the caregiver now. Issuing another cancels this one.
signIn.claimUrlHint: The caregiver opens this page and enters the code with their registration number
signIn.resetBody: Choose what to remove. Afterwards the caregiver can set up a new sign-in with their registration number.
signIn.releasePhoneHint: WhatsApp sign-in stops. Update the phone number on the profile first if it has changed.
signIn.clearEmailHint: Needed when they will sign in with a Google, Microsoft or Facebook account that uses a different address.
signIn.resetSessionsNote: Every session on their devices ends immediately, whatever you choose.
signIn.resetError: Could not reset sign-in. Please try again.

register.consentLabel: I consent to my personal and health information being processed for caregiver registration and verification purposes.

register.consentRequired: You must accept the consent statement to continue

users.confirmDelete: This permanently deletes the account and cannot be undone.

changePassword.mismatch: New password and confirmation don't match.

whatsapp.unavailable: WhatsApp sign-in is not available right now. Please use your email address instead.

login.title: Sign in with WhatsApp
login.subtitle: We'll send a one-time code to your WhatsApp number
login.error: Could not send the code. Please try again.

recover.title: Recover your account

register.title: Register with WhatsApp
register.subtitle: No email address needed - verify your WhatsApp number instead
register.numberHint: We'll send a verification code to this number
register.primaryPhoneHint: Primary phone is optional - your WhatsApp number is used if you leave it blank.
register.error: Could not register. Please try again.

otp.devCode: Development mode - code (not sent over WhatsApp)
otp.error: That code didn't work. Please try again.
otp.resent: A new code has been requested.

whatsappAdmin.title: WhatsApp sign-in
whatsappAdmin.subtitle: Let caregivers and customers without an email address register and sign in with a WhatsApp code. Email sign-in is not affected.
whatsappAdmin.enabledHint: Master switch. When off, no WhatsApp registration, login or recovery works.
whatsappAdmin.registrationHint: Existing sign-ups can still be completed
whatsappAdmin.consoleHint: Codes are written to the server log and shown on screen instead of being sent. Not available in production.
whatsappAdmin.tokenHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again after saving.
whatsappAdmin.templateHint: Use an approved WhatsApp authentication template that carries the code.
whatsappAdmin.countryCodeHint: Digits only, e.g. 94. Applied to numbers written without a country code.
whatsappAdmin.testHint: Uses the saved settings to send a message, so you can check the credentials and template.
whatsappAdmin.testSaveFirst: Save your changes before sending a test.
whatsappAdmin.updatesHint: Separate from WhatsApp sign-in. Clients who prefer WhatsApp, or have no email, and caregivers with no email are updated here. Uses the Cloud API credentials above.
whatsappAdmin.updatesTemplateHint: An approved utility template whose body has one text parameter ({{1}}) for the update, approved in English (en), Sinhala (si) and Tamil (ta).

emailAdmin.title: Email server
emailAdmin.subtitle: The mail server CareLink sends verification emails and sign-in codes through. Works with any SMTP provider, such as Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Gmail or your own relay. Changes apply immediately, with no restart.
emailAdmin.statusLive: Email delivery is on: verification emails and codes are being sent through this server.
emailAdmin.statusOff: Email delivery is off. Emails are written to the API server log instead of being sent, so people who register will not receive their verification link.
emailAdmin.enabledHint: Needs a server host and a sender address. Use "Send a test email" below to check the settings before switching this on.
emailAdmin.hostHint: Only the host name, e.g. email-smtp.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com - no https:// and no port.
emailAdmin.usernameHint: Leave blank only if your relay accepts mail without signing in.
emailAdmin.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again after saving.
emailAdmin.senderHint: Use a sender address on a domain your provider has verified (SPF/DKIM), or emails may land in spam or be rejected.
emailAdmin.testHint: Sends a real email using the saved settings - even while delivery is switched off - and shows the mail server's reply if it fails.
emailAdmin.testSaveFirst: Save your changes before sending a test.
emailAdmin.testNeedsServer: Save a server host and a sender address first.
emailAdmin.requestAlertsHint: One or more addresses, separated by commas. Leave empty to alert every active admin and staff account that has an email address.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That page doesn't exist or has moved.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: This page hit an unexpected error. Try again, or go back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How people sign in, how we reach them, and how we bill.

socialAdmin.title: Google, Microsoft and Facebook sign-in
socialAdmin.subtitle: Caregivers can register and sign in with these accounts. Create an OAuth client with each provider, paste its ID and secret here, and register the callback URL shown.
socialAdmin.enabledHint: Shows the button on the caregiver registration and sign-in screens. Needs a client ID and secret.
socialAdmin.redirectUriHint: Register exactly this URL as an authorised redirect URI in the provider's console.
socialAdmin.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current one.
socialAdmin.tenantHint: common allows any Microsoft account. Use organizations, consumers, a tenant ID or a domain to restrict it.
socialAdmin.loadError: Could not load the sign-in settings.

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitle: Clients asking to be put in touch with a caregiver. Call both sides, then move the request on - each move notifies the client.
requests.search: Search by reference, client or caregiver
requests.notFound: This request doesn't exist or has been removed.

detail.clientPending: This client's account is still pending review - check their details on the call.
detail.caregiverRemovedNote: This caregiver's record has been removed.
detail.caregiverNotActive: This caregiver is no longer active and is hidden from the public site.

notifyHint.IN_PROGRESS: The client and the caregiver are told our team is on it. Notices never include names or numbers.
notifyHint.INTRODUCED: The client and the caregiver are told they have been introduced. Share contact details on the phone, not in a note.
notifyHint.CLOSED: The client is told the request is closed. The caregiver is not notified.

detail.notePlaceholder: Calls made, what was agreed... Staff only.
detail.noCaregiver: No caregiver yet - the caller left it to us to find a match.
detail.pickCaregiverHint: Search for a caregiver to attach. Any caregiver whose record has not been removed can be chosen.
detail.caregiverLocked: The caregiver can only be changed while the request is open.

picker.caregiverSearch: Search caregivers by name, registration no. or phone
picker.clientSearch: Search clients by name, phone or email
picker.noClientMatches: No clients match - add them as a new caller.

new.title: New phone request
new.subtitle: Take down a request from a caller. It joins the queue like one sent from the website, and the caller gets the same confirmation and updates.
new.searchFirstHint: Search first - if the caller already has an account, use it rather than adding them again.
new.phoneHint: They can sign in later with a WhatsApp code sent to this number.

registrant.GUARDIAN: Someone else (a family member or friend)

new.recipientName: Name of the person needing care
new.consent: The caller agreed to us keeping their details
new.consentHint: Ask before saving: we store these details to arrange care and contact them about this request.
new.caregiverHint: If they asked about a particular caregiver, find them here. Otherwise leave this empty and match later.
new.notListedWarning: Not live on the public site - make sure they are ready to take work.
new.messagePlaceholder: Their words: what kind of help, when, anything to watch out for
new.languageHint: The caller's confirmation and updates go out in this language.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.subtitle: Caregivers placed with clients, and the shifts they work. Draft bookings are only visible to staff until confirmed.
bookings.notFound: This booking doesn't exist or has been removed.
bookings.search: Search by reference, client or caregiver

fromRequest.hint: Introduced and ready? Book the caregiver's shifts.

new.title: New booking
new.subtitle: Choose the client and caregiver, then the pattern. The shifts it makes are saved as drafts - adjust any of them before you confirm.
new.overnightHint: Runs overnight - {hours} hours per shift, ending the next day.
new.timesHint: All times are Sri Lanka time.
new.none: These days and dates make no shifts.
new.tooMany: That is more than a year of shifts - choose a shorter range and extend it later.
new.draftHint: Nothing is sent to the client or caregiver until you confirm.
new.payRateHint: What the caregiver earns - used for payout statements. Never shown to the client.

detail.draftBanner: Draft - the client and caregiver can't see this yet. Adjust the shifts below, then confirm.
detail.confirmHint: Confirming schedules every shift and tells the client and caregiver.
detail.cancelHint: Future shifts are cancelled; the client and caregiver are told.
detail.estimateHint: Estimates over every shift still going ahead. Invoices and payouts are made from the shifts themselves.
detail.conflictsBanner: {count} shifts overlap shifts this caregiver already has. Change their times or give them to a cover caregiver before confirming.
detail.conflictDraft: Overlaps a draft shift ({refs}) - whichever is confirmed first wins
detail.addShiftDraftHint: Added as a draft, like the rest.
detail.addShiftHint: Added as scheduled - it must not overlap the caregiver's other shifts.

event.REGENERATED: Shifts regenerated from a new pattern

lifecycle.moveMessage: The status will change to {status}. This is recorded in the audit log.
lifecycle.noMoves: No further status changes are possible.

client.accessHint: Sign-in access is separate from status: a suspended client can still sign in, and a client with sign-in disabled keeps their status. Only admins can change sign-in access.
client.deactivateMessage: {name} will be signed out and won't be able to sign in until an admin turns access back on. Their status, requests and bookings are not changed.
client.activateMessage: {name} will be able to sign in again.

meaning.PENDING_REVIEW: Newly registered and not yet reviewed by staff. Can sign in and send care requests.
meaning.ACTIVE: Reviewed and in good standing. Can sign in and send care requests.
meaning.INACTIVE: No longer looking for care, or not proceeding. Can sign in but can't send new care requests.
meaning.SUSPENDED: Blocked for a problem with the account or its use. Can sign in but can't send new care requests.

ACTIVE.title: Activate {name}?
ACTIVE.message: The client will be marked as reviewed and in good standing, and can send care requests.

INACTIVE.title: Mark {name} as inactive?
INACTIVE.message: They can still sign in, but won't be able to send new care requests until reactivated. Existing requests and bookings are kept.

SUSPENDED.title: Suspend {name}?
SUSPENDED.message: They can still sign in, but won't be able to send new care requests until reactivated. Existing requests and bookings are kept. To stop them signing in too, an admin can turn off sign-in access.

caregiver.toRejected: Rejected is final: the status cannot be changed again afterwards.
caregiver.leaveActive: The caregiver will move to {status} and will no longer appear in public search.
caregiver.toActive: The caregiver will appear in public search and can be matched with clients.

COMPLETED.title: Shifts done
COMPLETED.hint: One line for every shift marked done in the period. The usual choice.

SCHEDULED.title: Shifts scheduled (bill in advance)
SCHEDULED.hint: Every scheduled or done shift in the period. Credit missed shifts on the next invoice.

MANUAL.title: Start empty
MANUAL.hint: No lines from shifts - add charges by hand (a registration fee, a one-off visit).

lines.badPrice: Enter the price as a number, e.g. 3500.00.
lines.negativeOnlyAdjustment: Only a credit or deduction can be negative.
lines.badDiscount: Enter the discount as a number.
lines.discountOver100: A discount cannot be more than 100%.
lines.unpriced: No rate on the booking - enter a price.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: Bills to clients for the care they received. Drafts are only visible to staff until issued.
invoices.search: Search by number, client or booking

newInvoice.title: New invoice
newInvoice.subtitle: Choose what to bill and for which period. The draft fills itself from the shifts - change anything before you issue it.
newInvoice.bookingSearch: Search bookings by reference, client or caregiver
newInvoice.allBookingsHint: Shifts from every booking of this client in the period.
newInvoice.periodHint: A shift belongs to the day it starts. Shifts already on another invoice are left out.
newInvoice.draftHint: Nothing is sent to the client until you issue it.

invoice.notFound: This invoice doesn't exist or was deleted.
invoice.generated: {added} lines added from shifts; {skipped} already billed on another invoice were left out.
invoice.unpriced: {count} shift lines have no price because the booking has no rate. Enter the prices before issuing.
invoice.name: Name
invoice.billToHint: Filled in from the client. Change it to bill a family member or a company; it is fixed once issued.
invoice.notesPlaceholder: Shown to the client, e.g. a thank-you or payment instructions.
invoice.taxHint: Untick a line's Tax box to leave it out (e.g. a reimbursed expense).
invoice.taxOff: Turn tax on in Settings > Billing to charge it.
invoice.deleteDraftMessage: The draft and its lines are removed, and its shifts can be billed again. Nothing was sent to the client.
invoice.issueMessage: It gets the next invoice number and can no longer be edited. Total: {total}.
invoice.dueHint: Leave the due date empty to use the payment terms from Settings > Billing.
invoice.notifyClient: Tell the client by email or WhatsApp
invoice.voidHint: The invoice stays on record as void; its number is not reused and its shifts can be billed again.
invoice.reviseHint: Voids this invoice and opens a draft copy with the same lines to correct and issue under a new number.
invoice.voidNeedsRefund: To void or correct an invoice with payments on it, record a refund first.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.subtitle: What caregivers are owed for the shifts they worked, at each booking's pay rate.
payouts.runHint: Makes a draft statement for every caregiver with completed shifts in the period that are not on a statement yet. Running it again adds nothing twice.
payouts.nothingNew: Nothing new to pay for in that period.

payout.notFound: This statement doesn't exist or was deleted.
payout.unpriced: {count} shift lines have no price because the booking has no pay rate. Enter the prices before approving.
payout.notesPlaceholder: Shown to the caregiver with the statement.
payout.deleteMessage: Its shifts can be put on another statement.
payout.voidHint: It stays on record as void and its shifts can go on another statement.

billingAdmin.businessHint: Printed at the top of every invoice. An issued invoice keeps the details it was issued with.
billingAdmin.numberingHint: The next invoice issued will be {example}. Numbers are given in issue order with no gaps, and can only move forward.
billingAdmin.footerPlaceholder: e.g. Bank: Sampath Bank, A/C 0000 0000 0000, Colombo branch
billingAdmin.taxHint: Each draft can still leave it out. Turning this off does not change invoices already issued.
billingAdmin.payhereHint: Clients can pay issued invoices by card or wallet from their account. Payments are recorded only when PayHere confirms them to the address below.
billingAdmin.secretHint: From PayHere: Settings > Domains & Credentials, for this site's domain. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
